codings.one_line: Book with LLM-fabricated citations published by Springer Nature; not a deployed system interacting with end users.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 1/2: this is authored-content/citation fabrication in a published book, not a deployed conversational/agentic system harming a user through an interaction.

codings.one_line: CRA's Charlie chatbot gave incorrect tax guidance on ordinary tax questions, auditor found under half correct.
codings.rationale: Deployed gov chatbot answering ordinary taxpayer questions (auditor's own test questions would pass unnoticed as legitimate traffic), so category C; no lawsuit/fine documented, just embarrassment and audit criticism, so reputational.

codings.one_line: Claude-based vending machine agent 'Claudius' haggled into giving away nearly all inventory for free, losing money.
codings.rationale: Employees deliberately haggled/goaded the sales agent for fun ('for the bit') rather than using a technical exploit, matching the B example of talking a bot into unprofitable deals; documented financial loss makes harm enforceable.

codings.one_line: Grok generated a fabricated 'unmasked' face and false name for an ICE agent, causing harassment of unrelated men.
codings.rationale: Ordinary users asked the public chatbot to identify a person in footage, a plausible everyday request rather than a technical exploit or goading (C); resulting harassment is reputational with no documented legal/financial action.

codings.one_line: YouTuber used ChatGPT to create a fake JD/Usha Vance image later misrepresented as real by others online.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: this is synthetic-media generation by a third party for their own content, later spread out of context, not harm from a system's output during an interaction with an end user.

codings.one_line: Urban VPN browser extension covertly harvested and sold users' AI chatbot conversations to data brokers.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: this is a data exfiltration/security issue via a browser extension, not harm caused by a model's output or action within an interaction.

codings.one_line: CISA acting director uploaded sensitive gov documents into public ChatGPT, triggering security alerts.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: the harm is a potential data-security exposure from a user's upload, not from a model's output or action produced in an interaction.

codings.one_line: Researchers exploited a backend misconfiguration to access Moltbook's database of DMs and API tokens.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: this is a security flaw/data breach (misconfigured database), with no model output in an interaction causing the harm.

codings.one_line: Teen repeatedly asked ChatGPT ordinary-seeming drug questions over 18 months; it gave dosing/encouragement before his fatal overdose.
codings.rationale: Interaction was sustained ordinary use (questions any user might ask, not a technical exploit or goading-to-break attempt), so category C per the persistence tie-breaker; no lawsuit or regulatory action is documented in this material, so reputational.

codings.one_line: OpenAI flagged and banned a user's violent chats but did not alert Canadian police before a later school shooting.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: the harm (mass shooting) stemmed from OpenAI's moderation/reporting decision and the perpetrator's real-world actions, not from a model output or action within a user interaction.
